config.label: Profile name in ~/
config.description: Profile name in ~/.config/qmediat/credentials (chmod 0600). Created by `npx @qmediat.io/gemini-code-context-mcp init`. Recommended; keeps your API key out of ~/.claude.json.

config.label: Fallback Tier 3 auth
config.description: Fallback Tier 3 auth. Your Gemini API key. Emits a warning at startup recommending you move it to the credentials profile via the init command.

config.label: Set to `true` to use Vertex AI backend via Application Default Credentials
config.description: Set to `true` to use Vertex AI backend via Application Default Credentials. Requires GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT.

config.label: GCP project ID when using Vertex AI backend
config.description: GCP project ID when using Vertex AI backend. Only read when GEMINI_USE_VERTEX=true.

config.label: Hard daily USD cap enforced locally
config.description: Hard daily USD cap enforced locally. Server refuses calls after the cap until UTC midnight. Unlimited if unset. Honoured by `ask`, `code`, and per-iteration by `ask_agentic`.

config.label: Model alias (`latest-pro`, `latest-pro-thinking`, `latest-flash`, `latest-lite`, `latest-vision`) or literal model ID
config.description: Model alias (`latest-pro`, `latest-pro-thinking`, `latest-flash`, `latest-lite`, `latest-vision`) or literal model ID. Default: `latest-pro`.

config.label: Context Cache TTL in seconds
config.description: Context Cache TTL in seconds. Default: 3600 (1 hour). Hot workspaces (<10 min since last use) auto-refresh via background watcher.
